description: A young woman stands in a bright desert at noon, wide shot with harsh sunlight.

spec.subject: A young woman, early 20s, slim build, wearing a light beige long-sleeve linen shirt, faded tan cargo pants, and dusty brown hiking boots; dark hair tied back low, no visible accessories.
spec.setting: Open desert at noon under a clear sky; pale sand and scattered low scrub in the foreground, a flat expanse of sun-bleached ground in the midground, and a low line of distant heat-shimmered dunes on the horizon in the background.
spec.action: She stands still, facing slightly into the sun.
spec.camera_angle: Extreme wide shot at eye level, subject slightly left of center with ample negative space
spec.lighting: Hard overhead sunlight from high above and slightly camera-right, creating short crisp shadows under her body and boots; high-contrast exposure with bright warm highlights and deep shadow edges; natural daylight palette with a faint blue sky reflection; no practicals; dry air with visible heat shimmer.
spec.style: Digital capture with fine grain, neutral-to-warm desert color grade, crisp detail and strong contrast, in the manner of a restrained location portrait with unembellished natural light.
